newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Olympia denied gaming licence by state.
newsitem.headline: Olympia denied gaming licence by state.

text.p: Olympia Industries Bhd said on Friday that its Diriwan Corp Sdn Bhd unit has been denied a gaming licence by eastern Sabah state's government.
In a statement, Olympia said it has been notified by the chief minister's department that Sabah's "stand on the issue of trading licence remains unchanged".

On April 19, Sabah state Chief Minister Yong Teck Lee was quoted as saying that the state government was firm in its decision, made a year ago, to not issue a business premises licence to Diriwan to operate its 200 lottery gaming outlets.
Olympia said it is now seeking clarification from the Ministry of Finance on the matter.
The Ministry of Finance had agreed to renew Diriwan's gaming licence, a move resisted by Sabah.
